name: focus-lock-functions
description: Root package for the Vercel serverless functions in api/. The site (landing) and dashboard build via vercel.json; this exists so the api/*.ts functions get @types/node when Vercel type-checks them. Note: do NOT add "type": "module" — it flips the bundled functions to ESM, which breaks the extensionless relative import of shared/survey at runtime (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
